title: Core functionality disappeared
body:
I absolutely loved the app. However all of sudden, the option to see streak for individual habit disappeared which makes the app completely useless. I can only see streak for the days when all habits were completed, but not for individual habit. So it’s a habit tracking app that doesn’t allow seeing my consistency with each habit. Ridiculous!

This is deeply disappointing and very confusing! Is my app glitching or you just decided to get rid of one of the core functions?
author: Murhph
